# A nonempty config missing apiVersion is not wiped after a failed load.
! exec openshift-install agent create agent-config-template --dir $WORK
stderr 'failed to fetch Agent Config'
stderr 'no version was provided'

cmp $WORK/agent-config.yaml $WORK/expected/agent-config.yaml

-- agent-config.yaml --
# intentionally invalid: missing apiVersion
kind: AgentConfig
metadata:
  name: broken
-- expected/agent-config.yaml --
# intentionally invalid: missing apiVersion
kind: AgentConfig
metadata:
  name: broken
